title: pvMPIMoveData
body:
## pvMPIMoveData

ParaView-internal data-delivery filter that moves polydata, unstructured grids or AMR data between MPI processes and between data server, render server and client: PassThrough leaves data where they are, Collect gathers them to one process and Clone copies them to all. Its output type is PolyData unless OutputDataType says otherwise. It exists for ParaView's rendering pipeline; in Schemaxis prefer pvAppendReduce or pvReductionFilter to gather data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Omitted, OutputDataType is PolyData; set it to Unstructured Grid or ImageData to match inputs of those types.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI or client-server behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `MPIMoveData`. Identity: `filters/MPIMoveData`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the MPI Move Data filter. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":[],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MoveMode` | Specify how the data is to be redistributed. | `{"type":"enum","values":["PassThrough","Collect","Clone"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"PassThrough"` |
| `OutputDataType` | The dataset type delivered. Omitted, it is PolyData, so set Unstructured Grid or ImageData when the input is of that type. | `{"type":"enum","values":["PolyData","Unstructured Grid","ImageData"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"PolyData"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvMPIMoveData",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
